races.name: Irish Stallion Farms EBF Fillies Maiden
races.verdict: WUNDERSCHON took another step forward in a Leopardstown Group 3 recently and looks the one to beat back in a maiden. San Juan de Lope is an appealing newcomer, while Petticoat Bay and Itstheonlyoneigot should improve on the back of promising debut runs.

races.name: Racing In The City Of Tribes Handicap
races.verdict: A chance is taken on EARLS who has dropped to 8 lb lower than when third in a stronger race here at the summer festival. Jp's Express is respected on the back of his good third in a big field at the Curragh recently. San Aer's fine Galway record, including 2 wins in this race, earns him a place on the shortlist along with Johnny Murtagh's Flash of Fire.

races.name: Electric Galway Maiden
races.verdict: This can go to NONSENSE, who made a really encouraging start to his career at the Curragh earlier this month and will have learnt plenty from that. The Aidan O'Brien duo Imposing and Oklahoma are feared most.

races.name: www.swordsecurity.com Nursery Handicap
races.verdict: WECOULDAVEHADITALL is given another chance to confirm the improvement she showed when third on her 1m Naas nursery debut last month. Gabby Hayes may have simply failed to handle all-weather last time and will be a threat if back to the level of his nursery debut third at the Curragh. The market should help guide to the nursery newcomers in the line-up.

races.name: Corrib Food Products Maiden
races.verdict: SPACEBOUND wasn't seen to best effect when fourth at the Curragh last time and he can build on that recent effort to open his account. The main danger could be Saliba, who wasted no time getting back on track when runner-up at Roscommon, while Subtle Shade appeals as an interesting newcomer for Joseph O'Brien.

races.name: Barna Recycling Handicap (0-60)
races.verdict: MOVIN AND GROOVIN has a positive profile for her current yard with a win and 2 places from 4 starts this season, so she is taken to resume winning ways with headgear now added. Real Petite arrives on the back of a ready success at Gowran and is feared most, ahead of God Knows.

races.name: Galway Handicap
races.verdict: BEN HUR has been in good heart in his 3 outings this season, making his second handicap start on the Flat a winning one at Leopardstown in August and runner-up in a listed handicap over hurdles since. He gets the vote ahead of the hat-trick seeking Ryefield Dasher, with Granville Street also considered.

races.name: Galway Races Handicap (0-60)
races.verdict: DARK SUMMIT is taken to build on his 2 promising placed efforts since joining Paul Flynn. Starting Monday, the thriving Inver Bay and low-mileage Emmet Mullins inmate The Rock Factor head the many possible dangers. Last year's winner You Make Me Smile would also need considering if getting a run.

races.name: Border Minstrel Dog Friendly Pub Maiden Hurdle (GBB Race)
races.verdict:
WILDE'S LEGACY and My Mate Aj stand out based on their bumper exploits. The former reached a higher level in that sphere and is selected to get his hurdling career off to a winning start.

  1. WILDE'S LEGACY (IRE)
  2. MY MATE AJ (IRE)
  3. CHAMPAGNE POWDER (FR)

races.name: Mini Golf At High Gosforth Park Novices' Handicap Chase
races.verdict:
The thriving LUMINARIES is taken to complete an October hat-trick now back over fences. Unpenalised Sedgefield scorer Royal Time is the obvious danger.

  1. LUMINARIES (IRE)
  2. ROYAL TIME (IRE)
  3. THEREYARE (IRE)

races.name: High Gosforth Park Golf Club Handicap Hurdle
races.verdict:
ALIDAM made little impact for Sophie Leech but has dropped to a very handy mark on his French form and is worth chancing setting out for a new yard in a refitted hood. Cawthorne Cracker seems sure to give another good account, while it remains early days for Ms Cindy Kate.

  1. ALIDAM (FR)
  2. CAWTHORNE CRACKER (IRE)
  3. MS CINDY KATE (IRE)

races.name: Sunday Lunch At The Border Minstrel Novices' Limited Handicap Chase (GBB Race)
races.verdict:
SILVER HILL appeals as one who can make up into a useful stayer for his good stable and is taken to deny Dunkerque a fifth win of an excellent first half of the season.

  1. SILVER HILL (IRE)
  2. DUNKERQUE (DEN)
  3. KENT DE THAIX (FR)

races.name: Dogs Welcome At The Border Minstrel Pub Handicap Hurdle
races.verdict:
NORTH OF RICHMOND ran too badly to be true on his handicap debut at Doncaster when last seen in February and is well worth another chance having beaten Codetalker, who's now rated 124, on his hurdling debut at Fakenham around this time last year. Jentobello and Roarin' Success head the dangers.

  1. NORTH OF RICHMOND (IRE)
  2. JENTOBELLO
  3. ROARIN' SUCCESS

races.name: attheraces.com/marketmovers Handicap Chase (GBB Race)
races.verdict:
In a contest where few arrive with compelling claims RULE ME IN is taken to build on his latest Newton Abbot second to a well-treated rival. The returning Empty Nest boasts decent C&D form and is a big player on his return. Humble Jumble could do better now switched to fences.

  1. RULE ME IN (IRE)
  2. EMPTY NEST (IRE)
  3. HUMBLE JUMBLE (IRE)

races.name: Breeders' Cup On Sky Sports Racing Open Maiden NH Flat Race (GBB Race)
races.verdict:
CAYENNE appeals on paper and is taken to provide his excellent yard with a winner from its first bumper runner of the season. Always Proud showed ability in a notably valuable event at Newbury on his debut in March and should be up to making even more of an impact in these calmer waters, while Mon Missel ought to be suited by this more galloping track and must enter calculations, too.

  1. CAYENNE
  2. ALWAYS PROUD
  3. MON MISSEL (FR)

races.name: Spooktacular Family Day Conditional Jockeys' Handicap Hurdle
races.verdict:
Both MR MACKAY and Court Cian return from a lengthy time off the track but they figure on a tempting mark and represent yards in excellent form. Marginal preference is for the former without the benefit of market clues. Crystal Glance looks a solid opponent.

  1. MR MACKAY (IRE)
  2. COURT CIAN (IRE)
  3. CRYSTAL GLANCE

races.name: Jodie Standing's Point-To-Point Recruits Novices' Hurdle (GBB Race)
races.verdict:
RATTLIN HOME looks a useful prospect in this sphere on the back of a very encouraging start to his career in a bumper 8 months ago and he can provide Dan Skelton with yet another winner. Simonsberg exceeded expectations at Chepstow and is a danger, while point recruit Back To Sea also needs respecting.

  1. RATTLIN HOME (IRE)
  2. SIMONSBERG (IRE)
  3. BACK TO SEA (IRE)

races.name: Kellyhill Financial Planning Mares' Handicap Hurdle
races.verdict:
There should be plenty more to come from QUEEN MAEVE this season and sure to be well prepared for this reappearance with this trip another plus, she makes lots of appeal. Crystal Spring and I Spy A Diva are feared most.

  1. QUEEN MAEVE (IRE)
  2. CRYSTAL SPRING (IRE)
  3. I SPY A DIVA

races.name: Mount Vines Novices' Handicap Chase (GBB Race)
races.verdict:
Plenty of depth to this handicap with chase debutants STRONG RUN, Just Golden and Douglas Hyde all expected to rate higher this season. Without the benefit of market clues they are preferred in that order.

  1. STRONG RUN
  2. JUST GOLDEN (IRE)
  3. DOUGLAS HYDE (IRE)

races.name: Bangor-On-Dee Handicap Chase
races.verdict:
INEDIT D'AMOUR finished ahead of a pair of next-time out winners when second on his return to fences 3 weeks ago and he looks the answer. Laristote and Riviera Walk are feared most tackling larger obstacles for the first time.

  1. INEDIT D'AMOUR (FR)
  2. LARISTOTE (FR)
  3. RIVIERA WALK (IRE)

races.name: Overton Handicap Chase (GBB Race)
races.verdict:
TWISTTHENIGHTAWAY won her first 2 starts in handicap hurdles, at this course on the second occasion, and she can leave behind a lesser effort as she makes her seasonal/chasing debut. Out of a useful chaser, she gets the vote ahead of The Big Breac who was successful on last season's return, with Bataillon completing the shortlist.

  1. TWISTTHENIGHTAWAY (IRE)
  2. THE BIG BREAC (IRE)
  3. BATAILLON

races.name: Racing To School EBF Maiden Stakes (GBB Race)
races.verdict:
CYBERSPACE matched his previous best when again finding only one too good at Hamilton 4 weeks ago and, with this sharper 5f test looking more suitable, he looks to hold solid claims. Muve On and Valentina Bonita each remain open to improvement and can provide the chief threats.

  1. CYBERSPACE
  2. MUVE ON
  3. VALENTINA BONITA (IRE)

races.name: Download The Raceday Ready App Nursery
races.verdict:
BY JOVE GRACE showed further improvement when getting off the mark in ready fashion at Hamilton 5 weeks ago and an opening handicap rating of 70 looks lenient with the step up to 6f another likely plus on nursery bow. She makes plenty of appeal, with C&D winner Bladey Lady and another nursery debutant, Water Angel, heading up the dangers.

  1. BY JOVE GRACE (IRE)
  2. BLADEY LADY (IRE)
  3. WATER ANGEL

races.name: Celebrating Helen MacKinnon's LX Years Handicap (Div 1)
races.verdict:
BATTENBURG BELLE wasn't at her best at Beverley when last seen but Rebecca Menzies' 3-time C&D winner has been given a short break ahead of this and may well bounce back with forecast conditions holding no fears. Impressor, Blue Jay Way and Desert Master are others to keep an eye on.

  1. BATTENBURG BELLE (IRE)
  2. IMPRESSOR (IRE)
  3. BLUE JAY WAY

races.name: Celebrating Helen MacKinnon's LX Years Handicap (Div 2)
races.verdict:
MY MATE MACKLEY has yet to finish out the frame in handicaps and proved game when adding to his tally at Brighton 3 weeks ago. He looks a big player on the back of a 3 lb rise in his pursuit of the hat-trick. Knicks faces his easiest assignment for a long time and ought to play a lead role from a career-low mark, with Eldeyaar and Ski Angel next best.

  1. MY MATE MACKLEY
  2. KNICKS (IRE)
  3. ELDEYAAR (IRE)

races.name: Remembering Kevin Lumb AKA Burnley Kevin Handicap
races.verdict:
A facile winner at Chester in September, MIRACULOUS will find this less demanding than recent assignments and with the step back up in trip another likely plus, he could well be the way to go. Yarmouth scorer Marching Mac thrives in testing conditions and is feared, with the selection's stablemate Manila Scouse another to consider.

  1. MIRACULOUS (IRE)
  2. MARCHING MAC (IRE)
  3. MANILA SCOUSE

races.name: Every Race Live On Racing TV Handicap
races.verdict:
HAVANA RUM shaped quite well when belatedly tackling 7f for the first time at Newcastle recently and is worth a chance to confirm that promise. Last year's winner Evocative Spark heads the many possible dangers along with Tim Easterby's pair Vince Le Prince and Mister Sox, both of whom know where the winning post is here.

  1. HAVANA RUM (IRE)
  2. EVOCATIVE SPARK (IRE)
  3. VINCE LE PRINCE

races.name: Bet At racingtv.com Handicap
races.verdict:
The class-dropping ROCK ON PEDRO gets the vote back on the Flat after a lay-off, with confidence in his chance increased should the betting vibes be strong. Lilykoy has found some improvement of late and is feared most. Corsican Caper and Ebony Maw, a former winner of this race, are others to consider.

  1. ROCK ON PEDRO (IRE)
  2. LILYKOY
  3. CORSICAN CAPER (IRE)

races.name: Jumps Season Starts 20th November Handicap (GBBPlus Race)
races.verdict:
The finale can go the way of SASSICAIA, who remains with potential as he moves up in trip making only his fourth handicap start. The 3-y-o gets the vote ahead of Aequitas, who left her reappearance run behind when third at Goodwood earlier this month, with Arrange also in the mix.

  1. SASSICAIA (IRE)
  2. AEQUITAS (FR)
  3. ARRANGE (IRE)

races.name: All Weather Championship Is Back 'Hands And Heels' Apprentice Handicap
races.verdict:
EIGHTY EIGHT placed twice from 3 starts at Dundalk early this year and has dropped to a career-low mark ahead of joining a yard which has a good record with new recruits. He is taken to get back to winning ways, at the chief expense of Bajan Bandit who arrives in good form, while Sant Alessio could also be in the mix.

  1. EIGHTY EIGHT (IRE)
  2. BAJAN BANDIT
  3. SANT ALESSIO (IRE)

races.name: AWC Finals Day At Newcastle 26th March EBF Maiden Fillies' Stakes (GBB Race)
races.verdict:
Preference is for the well-bred AMBIENCE, who shaped well on her second start when runner-up in a C&D novice last month. She can continue her progress to go one better, though Show Me Glory is much respected for her leading yard, with Constella also one to note on the back of her first run.

  1. AMBIENCE
  2. SHOW ME GLORY (IRE)
  3. CONSTELLA (IRE)

races.name: AWC Season 14 Has Begun Restricted Novice Stakes (GBB/GBBPlus Race)
races.verdict:
BOY BASILICA was well supported on his recent Kempton debut and offered plenty to work on. He gets the nod, with newcomers Zeuster and Joseph Banks perhaps providing the chief threat.

  1. BOY BASILICA (FR)
  2. ZEUSTER
  3. JOSEPH BANKS (IRE)

races.name: Saisons D'Or 100th Race Handicap (Div 1)
races.verdict:
RIDGER arrives at the top of his game and makes plenty of appeal in his hat-trick bid with Oisin Murphy aboard. Mini Mac has dropped to an attractive mark and is much respected on debut for James Owen, whilst On Key also enters calculations.

  1. RIDGER (IRE)
  2. MINI MAC (IRE)
  3. ON KEY

races.name: AW Trials Day - Lingfield 2nd Jan 2027 Handicap (Div 2)
races.verdict:
It's hard to get away from the in-form DISTILLATE, who escapes a penalty for her latest comfortable Southwell victory. Midnight's Dream and Lady Delila head the list of dangers.

  1. DISTILLATE
  2. MIDNIGHT'S DREAM (IRE)
  3. LADY DELILA (IRE)

races.name: Midnite A Next Generation Betting App Handicap
races.verdict:
Marginal preference is for BESSIE WALLIS who got right back on track when just denied at Brighton last time and is fancied to go one better off the same mark here. Hvar has failed to hit top form for John and Sean Quinn but can boast winning C&D form and is not ruled out with Oisin Murphy an eye-catching booking. Territorial Star and Barry The Worm also warrant plenty of respect in this very open-looking handicap.

  1. BESSIE WALLIS (IRE)
  2. HVAR
  3. TERRITORIAL STAR

races.name: Midnite Built Different Handicap
races.verdict:
Plenty are in with a shout but the vote goes to CHARLIE'S CHOICE who wasn't knocked about after an absence when a recent Kempton eighth and can take a sizeable step forward to bag a fourth all-weather victory of 2026 now. Everyoneknowsadave also has winning form round here and heads the list of dangers, while Made All and Fahidi also need factoring in.

  1. CHARLIE'S CHOICE
  2. EVERYONEKNOWSADAVE (IRE)
  3. MADE ALL

races.name: Midnite It's Actually Pretty Good Handicap
races.verdict:
This is wide open but KAARANAH continues at the top of his game so is taken to bag a fifth C&D victory off the same mark as when a very good recent C&D second here. Mythical Bird is also weighted to go well and next on the list ahead of Newfangled and Roi De Coeur.

  1. KAARANAH (IRE)
  2. MYTHICAL BIRD (IRE)
  3. NEWFANGLED (IRE)

races.name: Make The Move To Midnite Handicap
races.verdict:
MACANUDO gets a confident vote to quickly resume winning ways with Billy Loughnane back in the saddle for the first time since going in over C&D. Cabeza De Llave is on a long losing sequence but arrives in good nick and rates next best ahead of low-mileage The Bear Of Saints and course specialist Gustav Graves.

  1. MACANUDO (IRE)
  2. CABEZA DE LLAVE
  3. THE BEAR OF SAINTS (FR)
